phases.goal: Close the rcode gap that causes content/SEO sites to be planned generically (as `web-app`) with no keyword clustering, E-E-A-T gates, or internal-link architecture. Implement four changes: (1) add `content-site` project type to `project-types.yaml` with full-spectrum SEO signals (local, affiliate, programmatic, technical, editorial, e-commerce, AI search, link-building — not just rank-and-rent), (2) route `content-site` projects in `rcode-project-researcher` to dedicated SEO skill agents, (3) add comprehensive SEO intent routing to `do.md` covering all SEO disciplines, (4) bundle 8 production-grade SEO skills from `~/.agents/skills/` into `rcode/skills/seo/` as an installable `--modules seo` module and wire the full `claude-seo:*` plugin fleet (17 agents). Closes #911, #912, #913, #914.
